title: Numbering-level w:ind in bidi lists: w:left is the start indent, w:right the end indent, w:hanging hangs on the start side; an absent w:left is 0
source: probe probe -> word.pdf (A4 pgMar 1200, Arial 10.5): right=360 hanging=360 -> marker 18pt outside the right margin, end indent 18 (physical left); left=360 hanging=360 -> start indent 18; hanging only -> start 0 / end 0; left=720 right=360 hanging=360 -> start 36 end 18

cases.note: level pPr w:bidi makes the item a bidi paragraph
hanging only: absent w:left = 0, the marker hangs 18pt outside the start margin
